title: tests/agent setup.sh E2E mlflow_server fixture: start each module's server from a copy of session cached_db, not a fresh migration
answers: Flaky CI: setup.sh remote-setup E2E tests fail because the MLflow server never becomes ready within the timeout
Where is the MLflow server used by the setup.sh remote-setup tests started, and which database does it use?
How do I add another setup.sh E2E test that needs a running MLflow tracking server with a database?
Why does each E2E test module get its own SQLite database and artifact root for the MLflow server?
body:
Path: tests/agent/test_setup_sh_e2e.py:mlflow_server is the module-scoped fixture that launches a real, unauthenticated `mlflow server` subprocess for the setup.sh remote-setup E2E tests and yields its base URL; it is the chokepoint for every test in that module that needs a live tracking server.
Rule: Seed the per-server database by copying the session-cached, pre-migrated SQLite file (`cached_db` fixture parameter) to `tmp_path / "mlflow.db"` with `shutil.copy2` before the process starts, instead of letting the server run schema migrations on an empty DB. Keep artifacts in a per-server `tmp_path / "artifacts"` directory passed as `--default-artifact-root`, and keep the existing readiness and cleanup logic unchanged. Pass `db_path` into `--backend-store-uri=sqlite:///{db_path}`.
Symptom: Remote-setup E2E tests intermittently failed because the server's first-run migrations were slow under CI load and exhausted the readiness timeout, so the server was never reachable and the test failed before any setup.sh assertion ran.
Constraints: Applies to fixtures that start a server against SQLite in tests/agent. The copy only avoids migration time if `cached_db` already holds the migrated schema; each module still gets its own DB file and artifact root so tests do not share state. Does not change product server code or the non-E2E tests.
applies: Applies to the module-scoped MLflow server fixture used by tests/agent/test_setup_sh_e2e.py; not to product server startup or other test directories.
says: Flaky setup.sh remote-setup E2E tests time out waiting for the MLflow server
MLflow server in setup.sh E2E tests never becomes ready within timeout
Seed the E2E test server database from the cached migrated SQLite file
Adding a setup.sh E2E test that needs a running MLflow tracking server
search: setup.sh remote-setup E2E module-scoped mlflow_server fixture: seed each server's SQLite database by copying the session-cached pre-migrated file instead of running migrations on an empty DB. Each module keeps its own database file and artifact root. Readiness and cleanup logic stay unchanged; does not affect product server code or non-E2E tests.
